content.text:
The test passes.

The change was a thin front-end addition — the backend already carried project `status` (migration `V21`, seed support, and `ProjectsGetLogic` all served it). I added:

1. **`features/projects/statusFilter.slot.tsx`** — a new self-contained toolbar control (`data-testid="project-status-filter"`) that owns a `projectStatus` URL search param, offering All / Active / On hold / Finished. It fills the existing `ProjectsToolbar` slot (order 30, after the tag filter).

2. **`features/projects/ProjectList.tsx`** — reads the same `projectStatus` key and adds one filter clause, mirroring how the list already filters by tag and archived state. The two features share only the URL key, no import.

`npm run typecheck` and `bin/e2e` both pass.
